notes.title: Improvements all around
notes.content:
A lot of small bug fixes and many performance improvement on the following tracks: Hazelwood Hills, Grootwood, Sandy Desert, Phala Beach, Stone Kingdom, Rainbow Star, Eilean Pathway, Bomboni Land, Aqua Chiara, Blocktown, Neon City, Dirt Race y Sticky Swamp.

Enjoy! 
-- EnsenaSoft Team

notes.title: Renzo Racer - Released!
notes.content:
We just released out of Early Access!  This release adds local 2 player support and localizations for French, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Italian, Danish, Finnish, Dutch and Swedish languages.

It also has many small improvements and final touches.  While the end of a long journey, it is the not the end of what we will do, we will continue to look at feedback for any further details.  So please let us know what you think.  :)

We hope you enjoy Renzo Racer!

-- The EnsenaSoft Team
-- Mazatlán, Mexico

notes.title: Renzo Racer now has GRAND PRIX mode!
notes.content:
Hi All!

It has been 3 month since our previous update. We have been hard at work on RENZO RACER and we have just completed an update to the game! 

We are really excited to be adding GRAND PRIX support into the game! This version also continues improvements in karts and boats.  While GREATLY improved, we realize we will need to be continuing this until the final release build.  

Our next version is going to add in VR support.  We hope to have that in January.  The version after that will be in March with power-ups.  The final version will add in 2 player mode and any final fixes and polish.  We are hoping for May release.  

We appreciate all your support and feedback.  Even negative feedback helps us improve.  Thanks to those have given feedback so far!

Cheers,
EnsenaSoft Team

notes.title: Updated Renzo Racer w/Improved Karts
notes.content:
Hi All!

It has been a month since our previous update. We have been hard at work on RENZO RACER and we have just completed an update to the game! 

Today’s update includes improved Kart handling and performance. 

Balancing each Kart to be perfect in terms of playability is a challenging and time-consuming task, and we hope that this update provides an overall better gameplay experience for your pleasure. 

We welcome any feedback you may have to the new and improved Kart performance. 

Our next update is already on the way and will focus on Boat performance improvement and Power-Ups. The update following that will be further enhancements and improvements to Karts, and even more Power-Ups! 

We have also adjusted our expectations in terms of official release. We expect the game will continue to be in Early Access for the next 9-12 months realistically. 

We welcome your opinion and we are excited to create a fantastic game with your help!

Sincerely,
EnsenaSoft

notes.title: Game Controls Overview
notes.content:
Here is a brief update to explain the games controls:

Keyboard:
- Arrow keys are used to control the vehicles and boats
- Space bar is hand brakes
- left shift - speed up the vehicles
- press G to switch camera view

Also supports game controller.
